name: Systematic Mind
body:
You are able to perform cognitive and analytical acts with startling alacrity.

Prerequisite: Int 13, Knowledge (any one) 6 ranks, Skill Focus (Knowledge (any one))

Benefit: Choose a number of Intelligence-based skills equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier. You can take 20 on these skills in relaxed circumstances as a full round action and take 10 in difficult or stressful situations (such as combat) as a standard action. You may opt to roll instead but you must take the die roll result in this case.
